Players Committee card image of [[Rey (ALT) (Errata 5)|Rey (ALT) (Errata 7)]] (errata PC-E7), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. Once per game, when deployed, may take any card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. Your total battle destiny here is +1. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 6 if on Jakku).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/rey_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/f0e499fbdb939727ddfad1dbd10bf65443919c4f f0e499f] (31 December 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
